head: The two hours in the great chair
text: Delhi took four pages to be appalled and Whitehall asked whether Barhampur had gone soft, and in your province — only in your province — the campaign was called off. Neither of you ever explained it. The photograph of the blanket in the gilt chair hangs now in two houses: his movement’s museum, and yours.

head: Ordinary traffic
text: Two hundred thousand at the city meeting, and nothing to be peaceable against: no martyr, no firing, nothing to build on but oratory, which fades. The CID’s temperature graph showed the year’s lowest reading the month after he crossed the far border. The clubs never forgave you the abdication. The graph did not care.

head: The text, printed at Government's press
text: The dawn arrest was courteous, the trial his masterpiece, and the sentencing magistrate’s tribute to the prisoner is quoted against Government for a generation. His own discipline held the province you had made ready to burn, and the pamphlets credit him the mercy, correctly. You gave the swaraj movement its decade of scripture, and signed the imprimatur.

head: The launch under the awning
text: The relief held because you were there, and the last three days were dictated from a cot with the rain on the roof. The photograph of an Honour carried half-conscious out of the water country did more for the Raj that month than the session did all year. The locked book gained a page. The convalescence took six weeks of the term, and the story was worth them.

head: The sentence from the grass
text: Two shots from the shrubbery, one through the shoulder, and the newsreel caught what you said from the ground — be still, it is nothing — before the aides reached you. The boy was taken alive because you insisted from the grass. The shoulder mended crooked. The sentence is quoted thirty years on, and was mostly annoyance at the interrupted band — which you have never told anyone, and the band suspects.

head: The hangman who counts
text: The hand and the trigger, distinguished in public, with reasons: two died, the boy who held the horses lives, and the prerogative was explained for the first time in the province’s memory. Both extremes were furious, which is the tax honesty pays. The revolutionary pamphlets’ title for you had two words, and no predecessor, the Chief Secretary observed, had earned the second.

head: The spine, re-articulated
text: The principle was sound and the six were the six: both true, and the armoury raid eleven months later proved the annexures you overruled. The CID never spoke of it to you again, which is its loudest register. You signed for the principle. The constable’s widow drew the pension for the arithmetic.

head: The unsigned certificate
text: The law’s slowness was paid for in advance, in a minute that counted the possible cost before it arrived — the hardest sentence you ever drafted. Eleven months of patient police work convicted where tribunals would merely have processed, and the swaraj movement’s press was reduced to attacking your patience. An instrument may serve best by being seen to be declined.

head: The last cold weather
text: Two days north, no secretary, the reports on the table between the glasses — and a man of famine-medal pride worked his final season dry and well, as if the sentence had lifted a siege. The Gazette paragraph was warm and true. What it cost him only you saw; what it cost you only he guessed. The Service, which saw nothing, learned that its failing men are safe to the pension with you, and that was worth five Divisions.

head: The founding legend
text: Two hundred thousand acres, fifteen-acre grants, the moneylender barred by the founding deed — and the bullock-carts on the new roads that cold weather were the province breathing out after a century. The Finance member mourned the auction receipts annually. The colony’s children are told of the year the sirkar gave the land to the men who plough, and the telling has your term inside it, nameless. Founding legends carry their architects so.

head: The road past the temple
text: One sentence — a public road is public — and eighteen months of holding it, and then the extraordinary decayed into the ordinary under guard. Forty years on, a Minister of the province will write of the morning his grandfather first walked past the temple gate upright. Files do not record what that is worth. His memoirs do, and they name no Lieutenant-Governor, and need not.

head: The entry framed in three union offices
text: Forty-eight hours, a judge named, the pickets bailed on the board’s own motion — and the strike’s coalition split along the line between substance and theatre. The mill-owners entered you in their books as a Bolshevik; the entry hangs framed in three union offices. It is the only honour of the term displayed anywhere at eye-level to working men, and you know which List that is.

head: The citation in one draft
text: Thirty years of plague camps went to the top of the sheet, over every better tailor in the province, and the citation needed no second draft. ‘I’ll wear it for the sub-assistant surgeons,’ he said. ‘They die of the plagues too.’ That sentence is in no citation. It is in the locked book where he keeps his notes on you, and yours on him, and both books close warm.

head: The margin of '83
text: The triggers moved early, and the signing minute compared the invoices: a false alarm costs a lakh; a true one answered late costs a district. Twice the new Code fired wrongly, and the lakhs watered works the rains then blessed. Once it fired rightly. The famine that did not happen has no monument except the Code itself, which will govern men who never learn your name for fifty years.

head: No other rule to offer
text: The senior vacancy went to the senior fit officer, minuted so the murmurs had nowhere to stand, and the northern Division met the man instead of the theory. The minute is cited now at other such files, in other provinces, by men who never heard of a dinner at Silchar. That is how doors stay open: one appointment at a time, with the reasons attached.

head: The rose bush
text: No negotiations, no concessions: weather reports exchanged between two men who each commanded a storm, and a province governed, some fortnights, by two unrecorded hours at Sonepore years ago. Delhi never knew. The CID knew and declined to minute it, the highest compliment its trade pays. Whitehall has a word for such channels. The country has another: it is the word for bridge.

head: The other administration
text: Half the province’s diplomacy was conducted this term at occasions you did not attend, by the one member of the administration Whitehall has never heard of. The purdah parties knew everything a season before the despatches. The girl from the Christmas camp ran the biggest house in the province the way she rode — lightly, completely — and the Vicereine’s letters, they say, are kept.

head: Closed at par
text: Twenty-two years of paper, ended in one stripping quarter: the securities sold at the bottom, the stable cut, the account closed at your own instance before the honours season could weigh it. Nearly poor, unowned, and asleep by eleven. The Bank’s annotation cannot be bought, only earned at ruinous rates, and you paid them, and it is yours: good for it, at the last, in full.

head: The eleven minutes
text: The address they walked out on ran eleven minutes and gave half of them to the empty seats, and the newsreel used your footage. It reads now like the term in miniature: short, plain, aimed past the theatre at the work. The Grand Cross was minted from a hundred such minutes. The benches, refilled by other men, still keep the door you named open.
